verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a local, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and multiplexer. Its documented data lives on the user's own machines: a local Lua config file, portable config next to the executable, and self-run mux servers over SSH or Unix domains. It runs no hosted storage service where a vendor-side region or residency choice would apply, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships one, so the axis is a category error for this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
